title: Establishment of ITRA
content: Paul Flood is recorded here as co-founder of the Irish Tag Rugby Association. This should be backed with ITRA archive material before being treated as a primary-source claim.

title: Passing of Paul Flood
content: Paul Flood passed away at age 53. Irish Rugby published a tribute/obituary on 4 April 2008.

title: Inaugural Cup Final
content: First Paul Flood Memorial Cup final held at Templeville Road between St. Mary’s College RFC and Old Belvedere RFC.

title: First Paul Flood Cup presented
content: Andrea Flood presented the cup to St. Mary’s after the inaugural final; Jonathan Flood gave a speech about his father.

title: Roll-call by 2014
content: Clondalkin’s 2014 match report describes Clondalkin joining previous winners St. Mary’s, Galwegians and Old Belvedere.

title: Inaugural Budweiser Tag All-Ireland Open — first Paul Flood Memorial Cup
content: The first-ever Budweiser Tag All-Ireland Open Championships took place at Galway Corinthians RFC in July 2008, with teams from all four provinces competing across A, B, C and Beginners grades. The A Grade winners also competed for the Paul Flood Memorial Cup, a new annual perpetual trophy held in honour of Paul Flood of the IRFU Leisure Rugby Department, who had passed away earlier that year. Finalists came from venues including Corinthians, Garryowen, Newforge, Colaiste Stiofain Naofa (Cork), Old Belvedere, Portlaoise and Suttonians, with referees drawn from every branch of the IRFU. Results — Paul Flood Memorial / A Grade Cup: EYPS Streamliners (runners-up Dirty Dozen), A Grade Plate: Dirtier Dozen; B Grade Cup: G-Whizz (runners-up Kingfisher Clan), B Grade Plate: Le Racing Club de Belfast; C Grade Cup: Fancy A Tag? (runners-up Sheep Taggers), C Grade Plate: Unmotivated; Beginners Cup: Wild Oysters (runners-up Cookie Monsters), Beginners Plate: Liqeurs. The winning teams were presented with their silverware by Scott Walker (Domestic Games Manager, IRFU), Martin Gallagher (Domestic Games Manager, Connacht Rugby) and Barry McCann (Corinthians Budweiser Tag Venue Manager). Event photographs were taken by Patrick Bolger Photography.
